headline: Santiago Peña accused of money laundering in Paraguay
summary: Paraguay's prosecutor's office charged former president Santiago Peña with money laundering and aggravated passive bribery in the Ueno bank intervention case. His brother and sister-in-law were also charged.
why: The Ueno bank intervention is a financial-sector case, and charges against a former head of state affect confidence in Paraguay's banking oversight and institutions.
original_headline: Santiago Peña acusado de lavado de activos en Paraguay
